title: Proposed private knowledge source extraction map v1
description: One source's private preparation configuration. Not a public bundle, executable selector, approval, object credential or source digest definition. Projection/config hashes are distinct from the full document reference. Registration, exact-byte correspondence, same-source context closure, complete field inventory, aggregate bundle limits, strict raw parsing and current source/permission checks remain semantic obligations. No compiler/retrieval behavior is established by shape.

projection_sha256.description: Exact admitted projection-byte association only; never substitute for document_sha256 or a containing map's hash.

text_pointer.description: Only concrete RFC 6901 array-index selectors in the registered text profile. Syntax does not prove an in-range field or admitted projection. No wildcard or expression.

required_context_passage_keys.description: Empty requires reviewed self-contained meaning. Larger than eight can describe valid stored context, but actual answer closure must refuse over-capacity groups; dangling/cross-source references remain semantic failures.
